source_reference: UI-02 Highlighter, Spotlight and Magnifier labels; emphasis index exports
fixture: Synthetic PNG with a bounded region and one highlight, spotlight and magnifier option.
trigger: Validate RenderEmphasisOptions and renderEmphasisToPngBlob for each effect.
target_observation_needed: Record rendered effect pixels, layering and configuration defaults.
ferby_observation_needed: Record validation result, output dimensions and rendered PNG bytes for each effect.
acceptance_rule: Compare effect output only with separately captured target pixels and configuration.
limitations: The public API proves an export and bounded options only; it does not prove editor wiring or visual equivalence.

source_reference: UI-03 Blur, Blur Text, Erase and Erase Text labels; emphasis index exports
fixture: Synthetic image containing a text region and a non-text region to conceal.
trigger: Apply the bounded emphasis renderer to conceal regions and test invalid bounds.
target_observation_needed: Record region/text targeting, exported pixels and error behavior; infer no privacy guarantee.
ferby_observation_needed: Record validateEmphasisOptions and output pixels/errors for valid and invalid options.
acceptance_rule: Compare only measured pixels, targeting and errors; do not treat concealment as a privacy guarantee.
limitations: No text-targeting or privacy contract is exported by the named module.

source_reference: UI-03 Resize Image width/height and Autoadjust labels
fixture: Synthetic image with non-square dimensions and width/height boundary values.
trigger: Resize with independent dimensions and Autoadjust variants.
target_observation_needed: Record resampling, aspect-ratio rules and exact Autoadjust changes.
ferby_observation_needed: Record any emphasis option dimension validation and output dimensions; no resize API is claimed.
acceptance_rule: Compare dimensions and pixels only after target and Ferby resize observations exist.
limitations: The named emphasis API is not a resize API; this case is an integration boundary, not a claimed implementation.

source_reference: UI-03 selection-size, PX/PT, logical-point and measurement-help labels
fixture: Synthetic selection at known coordinates tested at multiple display scales.
trigger: Measure selection size in pixel, point and logical-point modes.
target_observation_needed: Record Retina scaling, displayed values and help-key behavior.
ferby_observation_needed: Record any bounded renderer dimensions and separately identify absent measurement wiring.
acceptance_rule: Compare measurement values only after target results; no measurement behavior is inferred from renderer dimensions.
limitations: No measurement or display-scale API is exported by the named emphasis index.

source_reference: UI-03 Copy Pixel Color, Text Color, Average Color and Color Format labels
fixture: Synthetic RGBA image with known pixels, text-like region and averaging region.
trigger: Sample pixel, text and average colors in each advertised format.
target_observation_needed: Record formats, sampling area, color space and clipboard result.
ferby_observation_needed: Record emphasis renderer validation/output only and separately mark color sampling as unavailable in the named API.
acceptance_rule: Compare color values and clipboard behavior only against measured target and Ferby implementations.
limitations: The named emphasis index exports no color sampling or clipboard function.
